motion.name: boot-scan
motion.purpose: Runs the one session diagnostic sweep.

components.name: Primary Command
components.description: A consequential mission action in phosphor blue.

components.name: Evidence Panel
components.description: A clipped scan field connected to the surrounding command network.
components.html:
[ MISSION QUEUE ]

Operational evidence belongs here.
components.css: .ds-evidence{padding:24px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-left:2px solid var(--accent);background:var(--paper);clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - 20px) 0,100% 20px,100% 100%,0 100%);color:var(--ink)}.ds-evidence header{font:720 17px 'Momentum Sans',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.095em}.ds-evidence p{color:var(--muted);font:400 12px/1.5 'Momentum Sans',sans-serif}

components.name: Metric Stepper
components.description: A rectilinear instrument control with 44px decrement and increment zones.

components.name: Range Control
components.css: .ds-range{display:inline-flex;padding:3px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface)}.ds-range button{height:28px;padding:0 10px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font:650 9px 'Momentum Mono',monospace;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-range button.active{background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent);box-shadow:inset 0 -1px var(--accent)}.ds-range button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:1px}

components.name: Evidence Cell
components.description: A square mission-record cell whose fill reports score and border reports record state.

narrative.overview: BATCOMPUTER is one continuous tactical workspace. A command mast establishes mission state, the active dossier owns daily execution, connected instruments report evidence, and the remaining sectors support review and course correction.

rules.name: Evidence Before Atmosphere
rules.body: Every tactical device must clarify state, hierarchy, selection, or relation.

rules.name: Signal Rarity
rules.body: Phosphor blue belongs to action, live state, focus, and correction; it is not ambient decoration.

rules.name: One Continuous System
rules.body: Use rails and shared rules to connect sectors; do not return to a gallery of floating cards.

dos: Do keep daily execution visually dominant.
Do use mono type for measured state and controls.
Do preserve missing, open, and closed evidence as distinct states.
donts: Don't copy third-party Batman emblems or interface assets.
Don't add glass cards, rainbow gradients, or decorative border glow.
Don't let tactical ornament reduce legibility or target size.
